{{Top|leg}}
The '''Battle of Blood Ridge''' was a battle fought between a small group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and a larger force of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vur IV]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. A small group of Mandalorians led by [[Worr Muugyn]] held the fortified position they named "[[Blood Ridge]]" and fought off the Jedi for several days.<ref name="Muugyn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Mandalorian Relics: Muugyn's Plan}}</ref>
